svg.text: The raw unclaimed gap, 264.1° to 22.4°, walked continuously. A guard shaves its width off each end;

text.font-family: Montserrat, Nimbus Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: what remains is the publishable home arc. The question the numbers cannot answer: where does it stop reading as blue,

text.font-family: Montserrat, Nimbus Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and where does it start reading as red?

svg.text: Hatched = shaved off by that guard. Tinted = what it publishes as authorable. Every guard keeps the palette;

text.font-family: Montserrat, Nimbus Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: they differ only in how much of the arc they hand to whoever authors the next value.
